question: Indicate which of the following statements regarding the physiology and structuring of the dream is true:

options.opa: During REM sleep, the sleep spindles and the K complexes appear.
options.opb: Body temperature decreases slightly during sleep.
options.opc: The first REM sleep period is usually longer than the rest.
options.opd: Phase I of non-REM sleep constitutes 30% of the total sleep time.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "During REM sleep" -> "Sleep spindles and K complexes appear" -> 80% CHAIN: "Body temperature regulation" -> "Decrease slightly during sleep" -> 90% CHAIN: "First REM sleep period" -> "Usually longer than the rest" -> 85% CHAIN: "Non-REM sleep" -> "Phase I constitutes -> 80%
analysis: During REM sleep, sleep spindles and K complexes do not appear. Body temperature typically decreases during sleep as part of the normal sleep-wake cycle. The first REM sleep period is usually shorter than the subsequent ones. Phase I of non-REM sleep usually constitutes about 5% of total sleep time.
